case.pattern_description: The transaction was an online purchase for $128.33 that directly triggered a customer-reported unauthorized charge dispute.
case.summary: Case HHG-004 was confirmed as card-not-present fraud with an exposure of $128.33 and a model fraud probability of 0.95. The customer directly reported the transaction as unauthorized at intake, which took precedence over automated risk scoring. Based on this direct customer denial, the card was blocked and the case was officially closed as fraud.

case.stop_reason: Customer's own unsolicited fraud report is decisive (Section 6).

sar.reason: No FILE_REPORT criteria met: exposure $128.33 does not exceed the $1,000 R2 threshold; no shared-device link was found (R6); pattern was not classified as undocumented (R9).

next_best_actions.what_changed: Customer directly reported this transaction as unauthorized at intake (model-assessed probability was 0.95); the customer's own report takes precedence, and the case was confirmed as fraud.
